**What gadget customization are you looking for?**
Reordering, colors, alarms, themes/profiles, or something not covered
by [what the fork already adds](../../README.md#what-does-the-fork-add)

**Additional context**
Anything else — screenshots, a mockup, a similar feature in another tool.
